_about: Tacitus in English, translator per title. Alfred John Church and William Jackson Brodribb: Annals (1876; 1906 printing) and Histories (1864; 1894 printing), raw IA; Germany and Agricola ('the Oxford translation revised'), clean Gutenberg. W. Hamilton Fyfe's Histories (Oxford, 1912; Gutenberg clears it as US PD; Fyfe d. 1965). Thomas Gordon (1728-31): Germany, clean Gutenberg; his Annals I-VI selection is already on the Adler shelf. Arthur Murphy's Dialogue on Oratory. Latin-facing Loebs of 1930 or earlier added 2026-10-02 as raw IA OCR (translator per row); the scan's printing was checked for a post-1930 revision notice where its title verso survives. Older translations from the wishlist added 2026-10-02 as raw IA OCR (translator per row).
